# Triangle Liquidators Live Auction Dashboard

> Real-time lot indexing, out-of-pocket total cost calculation, savings estimates, and custom watchlist management.

## Overview
The Triangle Liquidators Live Auction Dashboard indexes active items from Triangle Liquidators auctions across Raleigh and South Carolina locations, providing automated total financial calculations (buyer's premium, NC/SC sales tax, credit card fees, out-of-pocket totals) and catalog filtering.

## Usage Policy & Crawler Guidelines
- Automated indexing of auction lots for user interface display is managed by the application backend.
- Automated data harvesting or training datasets via AI bots is not permitted without explicit authorization (see robots.txt).

## System API & Data Access
- Official website: https://auction.triangleliquidators.com/
- Contact & Support: Triangle Liquidators Support
